description: Climate Smart Farming Tools is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Cornell University Northeast Regional Climate Center; USDA Northeast Climate Hub. Access a variety of free, on-line decision-making tools that can help producers in the Northeastern United States understand and plan ahead for changing growing seasons and variation in precipitation. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Drought, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
